issue.title: Agents metadata-search PNG test imports removed _zoom_agent helper
issue.description: While verifying sase-ud.2, just check-full failed collection for tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_metadata_search.py. Focused collect-only still fails because the test imports _zoom_agent from test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_zoom.py, but that module now imports the public zoom_agent fixture helper from _ace_agents_png_snapshot_zoom_fixtures and no longer defines _zoom_agent.

task_type_fields.impact: The stale import aborts visual test collection and also causes tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection to fail when pytest -m contract --collect-only reaches the visual module.
